accepted_findings.disposition: Fusion materials are collected after the mandatory Token is created; the activation guard separately proves a Dragon material and a summonable named Fusion.

accepted_findings.detail: e1: s.fustg does not visibly guard s.fusop's Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.matfilter|tp|LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_MZONE|0).
accepted_findings.disposition: The second material-group read applies the selected Fusion Monster to the same post-Token material pool; activation legality is established by dragonmat and fusfilter.

accepted_findings.detail: e2: s.tgtg does not visibly guard s.tgop's Duel.SelectMatchingCard(f|tp|LOCATION_DECK|0).
accepted_findings.disposition: The operation deliberately selects with one of two predicates chosen and stored by the target callback. Both option predicates are checked at activation.

accepted_findings.detail: e4: s.recruittg does not visibly guard s.recruitop's Duel.SelectMatchingCard(s.spfilter|tp|LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_GRAVE+LOCATION_EXTRA|0).
accepted_findings.disposition: The cost returns this monster to hand and frees its Main Monster Zone. recruittg uses precruitfilter with the pre-cost released monster and a prospective self-Summon check; recruitop uses spfilter on the post-cost state. Both filters enforce the same archetype, monster, face-up Extra Deck and Summonability constraints; the zone predicates intentionally differ across payment.

accepted_findings.detail: e2: s.eqtg does not visibly guard s.eqop's Duel.SelectMatchingCard(s.canEquipTo|tp|LOCATION_MZONE|0).
accepted_findings.disposition: eqtg targets a GY equip candidate through eqfilter. eqfilter itself requires an existing canEquipTo recipient. eqop refilters targeted cards through eqfilter before choosing that recipient, and rechecks Spell/Trap zone capacity per card. The recipient search is guarded transitively through the target filter.

accepted_findings.detail: e1: s.acttg does not visibly guard s.actop's Duel.SelectMatchingCard(s.destroyable|tp|LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_ONFIELD|0).
accepted_findings.disposition: This optional activation follow-up is chosen in acttg only if activationvictim exists; that predicate requires a destructible card and both retrieval destinations (including a victim that will reach GY). actop checks its activation label and card relation, selects a destructible victim, then separately rechecks both retrieval pools after destruction. The broad resolution selection is intentional, not an unguarded mandatory activation.

accepted_findings.detail: e1: s.sptg does not visibly guard s.spop's Duel.SelectMatchingCard(s.desfilter|tp|LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_MZONE|0).
accepted_findings.disposition: The activation requires deslegal, which combines the same desfilter with prospective zone availability after destruction. Resolution selects with desfilter, destroys it, then independently rechecks the two-monster Summon legality and two free zones before Summoning. Different predicates account for the prospective and actual post-destruction states.

accepted_findings.disposition: Activation uses s.options to validate selectable mode. The own-monster search occurs only in a banish-selected mode and both own and opposing removable monster groups are explicitly rechecked immediately before selection.

accepted_findings.detail: e1: s.destg does not visibly guard s.desop's Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.dgfilter|tp|LOCATION_MZONE|LOCATION_MZONE).
accepted_findings.disposition: False positive: the target callback guards and chooses the printed reference Effect Monster. The operation does not make a second selection; Duel.GetMatchingGroup intentionally enumerates the distinct printed group of all other face-up Effect Monsters sharing a characteristic with that chosen monster, so its dgfilter predicate must differ from the activation guard.

accepted_findings.detail: e2: s.sptg does not visibly guard s.spop's Duel.SelectMatchingCard(s.spfilter|tp|LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK|0).
accepted_findings.disposition: rmfilter validates that each banishable card has the corresponding named summon available; the later spfilter selection uses the code determined by the card actually banished.

accepted_findings.detail: e1: s.sstg does not visibly guard s.ssop's Duel.SelectMatchingCard(s.desfilter|tp|LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_ONFIELD|0).
accepted_findings.disposition: The target uses spacefilter, which includes desfilter and proves a zone exists or can be opened by the victim. Resolution selects the MZONE subset when needed, otherwise desfilter, then checks actual destruction and free zone before summoning.

accepted_findings.detail: e2: s.revtg does not visibly guard s.revop's Duel.SelectMatchingCard(s.destroyfilter|tp|LOCATION_ONFIELD|0).
accepted_findings.disposition: The target uses spacefilter including destroyfilter and prospective zone opening. Resolution narrows to an MZONE victim when full, checks actual destruction, related source and available zone before revival; the optional opponent overlay is independently guarded.

accepted_findings.disposition: Activation checks for at least one negatable monster and draw legality. Resolution enumerates all face-up monsters, applies the negate predicate individually, then counts the opponent's current face-up monsters.
